items.title: Machine Learning Specialization
items.description: Building and training ML models in Python using NumPy, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow — from linear/logistic regression to neural networks, decision trees, and ensemble methods (random forests, boosted trees).

items.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning Professional Certificate
items.description: Building neural networks from scratch in PyTorch; working with TorchVision and Hugging Face models; fine-tuning pretrained models; exploring Siamese networks, ResNets, and Transformers; preparing models for deployment with ONNX, MLflow, pruning, and quantization.
